title: Hamiltonian cycles in Dirac graphs
statement:

$$
\Psi(G)\ge \frac{n!}{(2+o(1))^n}.
$$

title: Maximal length of strongly free quadratic sequences
statement:
For $h=2$, one can find strongly free sequences $r_1,\\ldots,r_m$ with $1\le m\le t(d)$, where
\[
t(d)=\begin{cases}d^2/4,&\text{if }d\text{ is even},\\(d-1)^2/4,&\text{if }d\text{ is odd}.
\end{cases}
\]
It is conjectured that $t(d)$ is the largest possible value of $m$.
